done_when: task_state.last_change ignores commits whose only hits inside a directory scope path are MyTradingSys/system/tasks/*.json (a scope path that names a card file itself still counts); cmd_stale calls TS.prefetch_changes like cmd_list; a test shows both commands agree and a card-only commit leaves a ready card not stale.
goal: A commit that only edits task card JSON under MyTradingSys/system/tasks/ no longer marks other cards STALE, and tasks.py list and tasks.py stale give the same verdict.

steps: Cause: task_state.last_change counts any commit touching a scope path; a scope of MyTradingSys/system/tasks/ is hit by every card commit. tasks.py cmd_stale (line ~899) does not call prefetch_changes, cmd_list (line ~829) does, so the two take different code paths (window+hint vs per-path git log).

In task_state add CARD_RE (MyTradingSys/system/tasks/*.json) and helper _counts(f, p): _hit(f,p) and not (CARD_RE matches f and p is a directory, not f itself). Use it in the prefetch loop of last_change.
Same rule in the git fallback: when a path is a directory add pathspec ':(exclude)MyTradingSys/system/tasks/*.json' only for dir paths; keep exact card-file paths unexcluded.
In tasks.py cmd_stale call TS.prefetch_changes(REPO) first, as cmd_list does, so both use one path.
Add the tests from the tests field to scripts/dev/test_tasks.py (temp repo, git init); confirm they fail with the edits stashed.
Run python scripts/dev/test_tasks.py and tasks.py stale on the real repo; ship.
tests: New tests in scripts/dev/test_tasks.py on a temp git repo: card with scope_in MyTradingSys/system/tasks, refresh, commit only a tasks/x.json, stale_reason == '' (fails on old code); then commit a non-card file in scope, stale_reason != ''; stale and list tags equal for both states.
title: tasks.py stale: a commit under system/tasks/ re-stales every card whose scope_in includes that dir, and list vs stale disagree on refresh time; done-when: card-only commits do not re-stale and both commands agree, with a test
